mods.name: Animon SoundFix
mods.description: Client-side Cobblemon sound fix for resource packs that provide separate Pokemon ambient and cry sounds.

releases.notes:
Updated NeoForge 1.0.3 build from [commit 608cc20](https://github.com/MrSal7y/animon_fix/commit/608cc204452e5a04a4138969eac8a7cf41910bc4). The version number is unchanged.

- Fixes duplicate send-out voices by using synchronized entity ownership on the client.
- Reduces overly frequent wild ambient requests, with independent random quiet periods and occasional skipped calls for each Pokémon.
- Keeps resource-pack ambient recordings and only uses default cries when ambient audio has no resource-pack override.
- The ambient randomization does not change send-out cries or generate extra wild sounds.
- Retains the NeoForge startup-crash fix. Fabric is unchanged.

For positive Cobblemon ambient intervals, successful wild calls are followed by a quiet period of 1–2 times that interval. Eligible calls have a 65% chance to play; a skipped call waits 0.25–0.75 intervals before it can be considered again. Actual timing also depends on incoming ambient requests. Setting the interval to zero disables this spacing and random filtering.

Replace the old `animon-fix-neoforge-1.0.3.jar` with this rebuilt file and restart Minecraft. Install only one SoundFix JAR.

Validation: the duplicate-voice and excessive-repeat correction was confirmed working in-game on the affected setup. All 28 automated tests pass against Cobblemon 1.7.3 and 1.8.1, and the build passes on Minecraft 1.21.1 / NeoForge 21.1.251. The subsequent ambient randomization has automated coverage and is installed for in-game evaluation. This remains a prerelease.

The attached `animon-fix-neoforge-1.0.3-source.zip` contains the exact updated source. GitHub's automatically generated source archives refer to the original release tag.

JAR SHA-256: `c389167cdc865f8f714dfb5bb0ebbe21598d1506892f47212bd466f5709f0acc`
